_spec: BANZA v1.0.0 L0 independent-implementation trial - PASS/FAIL criteria, frozen before the trial
_frozen: These criteria were fixed before any external implementation existed. They are not adjusted after seeing a result.

pass_requires_all.criterion: frozen package content digest confirmed by the team before work began
BCJ/1 gate PASS - byte equality on every applicable vector
every required L0 positive case passes
every required L0 negative case passes
no unresolved MISSING_RULE in the ledger
no unresolved CONFLICT in the ledger
no unresolved material AMBIGUITY in the ledger
hostile inputs cause no crash, hang or panic
the external implementation was frozen before any reference comparison
every discrepancy adjudicated against the normative surface, never against the reference

specification_blocked_when: the team cannot proceed because the public surface does not determine something L0 requires, and no EXISTING_RULE answer is available
invalid_trial_when: isolation or independence was breached, or the target moved without being detected
interrupted_when: a spec, contract, schema, registry, required vector, profile semantic or capability semantic changed during the run
claim_if_pass: An independent external implementation of the BANZA v1.0.0 L0 profile was demonstrated against a pre-registered public implementation package and test procedure.
